summary: Trump argues that if Democrats win, oil production would be shut down and prices would skyrocket; he frames high oil production as essential to keeping prices down, and warns oil would 'go through the roof' under a Democratic administration. He also notes high oil prices (near $100/barrel) helped fund Russia's war in Ukraine.
quote: If this election were won by them, I can tell you right now, you would be— we would see oil go through the roof because they would really close it up... when it hit almost $100 a barrel, he said— he's one of the few to make money during a war because the oil has gone— and it stayed very high. It's extremely high right now and it's going up.
scoreReason: Trump's claim that oil would 'go through the roof' under Democrats is political/policy rhetoric, not a genuine investment or market directional take. The framing is entirely about policy consequences, not a market call.
